$comment: Diagnostic repair transcripts (PRD FR-15). Each entry shows a broken program, the stable diagnostic code the compiler emits, and the repaired program. Validated by tests/corpus.test.ts.

repairs.name: typo in a style prop
repairs.note: Unknown property; the diagnostic includes a ':color' suggestion.

repairs.name: reference to an undeclared name
repairs.note: count was never declared; declare state before use.

repairs.name: navigation to a route that does not exist
repairs.note: nav targets must match a declared page route.

repairs.name: missing route parameter
repairs.note: path templates require every {param} to be supplied.

repairs.name: arithmetic on a string
repairs.note: Use concat for strings; + is numeric.

repairs.name: wrong argument count in a fn call
repairs.note: double takes one parameter; the diagnostic shows the expected shape.

repairs.name: lambda with the wrong arity for reduce
repairs.note: reduce folds with a two-parameter function (acc x).

repairs.name: dialog without open state
repairs.note: dialog requires :open bound to a boolean state.

repairs.name: stagger without an entrance animation
repairs.note: :stagger sequences the children of an :enter animation.

repairs.name: insert into a column that does not exist
repairs.note: The table declares :name; the diagnostic suggests it for the :nmae typo.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :nmae body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))

repairs.name: send to a route the api does not declare
repairs.note: send must target a declared (api ...) route with a matching method.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wish" :name n)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes" :name n)))))

repairs.name: server op used in a page expression
repairs.note: select/insert/update/delete-row only run inside (api ...) handlers; pages read through resources.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes))) (page "/" home (txt (count (select wishes)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes))) (data (resource wishes "/api/wishes" :default (arr))) (page "/" home (txt (count wishes.data))))

repairs.name: body field not in the input contract
repairs.note: Routes with (input ...) reject undeclared body fields; declare the field or fix the name.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.nmae))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))

repairs.name: send body missing a required input field
repairs.note: The route contract declares (name string); the send must supply it.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes")))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes" :name n)))))

repairs.name: unknown enum member
repairs.note: Enums are read as name.member; the diagnostic lists the valid members.
repairs.broken: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (btn "Done" (click (set s status.finished)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (btn "Done" (click (set s status.closed)))))

repairs.name: auth guard without an auth declaration
repairs.note: :auth true requires (auth users) so sessions exist.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (get "/api/notes" :auth true (select notes))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (auth users) (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (get "/api/notes" :auth true (select notes))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))

repairs.name: non-exhaustive match over an enum
repairs.note: match over an enum-typed value must cover every member or end with (else ...).
repairs.broken: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (txt (match s ("open" "O")))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (txt (match s ("open" "O") ("closed" "C")))))

repairs.name: live resource without a server
repairs.note: :live true subscribes to the generated server's change feed, so the app must declare (db ...) or (api ...).
repairs.broken: (app a (data (resource notes "/api/notes" :live true)) (page "/" home (each n notes.data (txt n.text))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (get "/api/notes" (select notes))) (data (resource notes "/api/notes" :live true)) (page "/" home (each n notes.data (txt n.text))))

repairs.name: file-input without an uploads declaration
repairs.note: file-input posts to /api/uploads, which only exists when the app declares (uploads ...).
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table t (id auto))) (state photo "") (page "/" home (file-input :label "Photo" :to photo)))
repairs.fixed: (app a (uploads) (db (table t (id auto))) (state photo "") (page "/" home (file-input :label "Photo" :to photo)))

repairs.name: server callback depends on browser globals
repairs.note: Server effect validation follows callbacks and let initializers; use only server-safe functions in an API handler.
repairs.broken: (app a (fn viewport (x) window.inner-width) (api (get "/api/widths" (let ((widths (map viewport (arr 1)))) widths))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (fn viewport (x) x) (api (get "/api/widths" (let ((widths (map viewport (arr 1)))) widths))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: known scalar used as a list callback
repairs.note: Higher-order list operations require a callable value; replace the numeric binding with a lambda or declared function.

repairs.name: column references an unknown table
repairs.note: :references must name a declared table; the foreign key targets its id column.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table votes (id auto) (note-id number :references notes))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string)) (table votes (id auto) (note-id number :references notes))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: nullable list lookup used as a required number
repairs.note: first, last, nth, and find can return no value; guard with not-null or provide an or-else fallback before arithmetic.

repairs.name: typed callback receives inferred string list elements
repairs.note: List element types flow into declared callback parameters. Supply the numeric elements required by the increment function.
repairs.broken: (app a (fn increment ((value number)) (+ value 1)) (page "/" home (txt (map increment (arr "one" "two")))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (fn increment ((value number)) (+ value 1)) (page "/" home (txt (map increment (arr 1 2)))))

repairs.name: optional input used for a required database column
repairs.note: Optional input fields keep their nullable scalar type. Supply a fallback before storing the value in a required column.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (post "/api/notes" (input (text string :optional true)) (insert notes :text body.text))) (page "/" home (txt "Notes")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (post "/api/notes" (input (text string :optional true)) (insert notes :text (or-else body.text "Untitled")))) (page "/" home (txt "Notes")))

repairs.name: numeric standard library operand
repairs.note: Math operations require non-null numeric inputs. Convert text explicitly.

repairs.name: private upload policy requires authentication
repairs.note: Declare auth before using owner-only upload storage.

repairs.name: inverted input range
repairs.note: Input constraints must have a valid range.

repairs.name: literal mutation exceeds input range
repairs.note: Literal sends are checked against declared bounds.
repairs.broken: (app a (api (post "/api/n" (input (n number :integer true :min 1 :max 10)) body.n)) (page "/" home (btn "Send" (click (send post "/api/n" :n 11)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (api (post "/api/n" (input (n number :integer true :min 1 :max 10)) body.n)) (page "/" home (btn "Send" (click (send post "/api/n" :n 5)))))

repairs.name: bounded skeleton generation
repairs.note: Static expansion must remain bounded.

repairs.name: reserved runtime endpoint
repairs.note: Health endpoints cannot be shadowed by application routes.
